title: Hermes PM default selection
description: Which optional PM packages (tools) and Python extras each kind of install selects by default. Root (non-optional) packages always install and are not listed. Rules apply in order; every rule matching the install kind and target contributes.

install.description: source = install.sh / install.ps1 / bare `hermes pm install` / `hermes update`; bundle = desktop payloads (MSIX, DMG, AppImage); docker = the published container image.

targets.description: PM target globs, e.g. win32-arm64, linux-*, *-arm64, *.

tools.description: Optional PM package names. "name" selects, "-name" deselects, "*" selects every optional package. A tool with no build for the target is skipped. Users decline source tools with `hermes pm install --without`.

extras.description: pyproject extras. "name" selects, "-name" deselects, "*" selects every declared extra except [tool.hermes] opt-in-extras.
